# Papers With Lean

> A daily-updated index of arXiv papers that use Lean, the interactive theorem
> prover (and Mathlib). Each entry is screened by an LLM relevance gate so the
> list is Lean-specific, not colloquial "lean". 752 papers as of 2026-08-24.

## Structured data (start here)

- [Full dataset (JSON)](https://paperswithlean.com/site_papers.json): every paper as a JSON
  object. Shape: `{"generated": "YYYY-MM-DD", "papers": [{...}]}`. Each paper
  has: `id` (arXiv id), `title`, `authors` (list), `abstract`, `abs_url`,
  `pdf_url`, `primary_category`, `published` (YYYY-MM-DD), `tags` (list),
  `lean_note` (one-line description of how the paper uses Lean), `repo` (code
  repo URL if any), `thumb` (first-page thumbnail path). Prefer this over
  scraping the HTML.
- [RSS feed](https://paperswithlean.com/feed.xml): the most recently added papers (recent
  window only, not the full archive).
- [Sitemap](https://paperswithlean.com/sitemap.xml): every page on the site.

## Pages

- [Home / searchable list](https://paperswithlean.com/): client-side search and time filters.
- Per-paper detail pages: `https://paperswithlean.com/paper/<arxiv-id>.html`.
- [Stats](https://paperswithlean.com/stat/): dataset statistics.

## Notes

- Source of truth is `site_papers.json`; the site is rebuilt daily from the
  arXiv API plus an LLM relevance/summary pass.
- arXiv ids are the stable key; a paper's detail page is always
  `https://paperswithlean.com/paper/<id>.html`.
